articles.title: India commissions third nuclear-powered submarine INS Aridaman
articles.summary: India officially inducted INS Aridaman, its third nuclear-powered submarine, at a ceremony in Visakhapatnam presided over by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh. This indigenously designed and manufactured vessel significantly enhances India's strategic naval capabilities and deterrence, reinforcing the nation's self-reliance in advanced defence technology. The move marks a crucial advancement for India's maritime security and strategic autonomy, bolstering its position in the Indo-Pacific region.

articles.title: Does ‘The Super Mario Galaxy Movie’ Set Up a Super Smash Bros. Movie Sequel?
articles.summary: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie is currently captivating audiences, fueling extensive fan speculation within the renowned Super Mario franchise. This latest animated film builds on the success of its 2023 predecessor and the popular video game series. Fans worldwide are keenly discussing the movie's details, making it a prominent topic in global entertainment news and a major release for the beloved Nintendo property.

articles.title: James Gadson, Drummer for Diana Ross and Bill Withers, Dead at 86
articles.summary: James Gadson, a legendary drummer, is highlighted for his extensive contributions to funk, soul, and disco music. Renowned for collaborations with iconic artists like Diana Ross, Bill Withers, and Marvin Gaye, his versatile discography also includes sessions with contemporary musicians such as Beck and Kelly Clarkson, showcasing his enduring impact across global music generations.

articles.title: NIT Semifinals: Tulsa advances, Illinois State and New Mexico’s seasons end
articles.summary: The Tulsa Golden Hurricane emerged victorious, defeating New Mexico at Hinkle Fieldhouse in Indianapolis. This concluded a Division-I mid-major basketball tournament that began on November 3rd with 280 programs. After intense competition, Tulsa stood as the sole remaining champion on April 3rd.

articles.title: ISRO launches Mission MITRA for safety of human spaceflight mission crew
articles.summary: ISRO conducted 'Mission MITRA' in Leh, Ladakh, from April 2-9. This unique initiative was a team behavioural study, crucial for understanding crew dynamics and psychological aspects vital for future human spaceflight missions. Simulating confined environments, it aims to enhance astronaut performance and teamwork in challenging conditions, directly benefiting India's ambitious Gaganyaan program.

articles.title: The age of the aircraft carrier is over
articles.summary: This Spectator article, penned by Andrew Cockburn, controversially posits that the age of the aircraft carrier has concluded. It likely delves into the historical role and significance of American aircraft carriers since World War Two, while exploring strategic shifts and emerging technologies that challenge their continued relevance in contemporary naval warfare. The piece appears to argue for a fundamental reassessment of these traditional defence assets.

articles.title: Pete Hegseth Gonna FIRE FAT CHICKS To VICTORY!
articles.summary: An article presents strong accusations against 'Secretary of WAR Pete Hegseth,' alleging his involvement in 'Godless war crimes.' These purported actions are claimed to span significant global regions, including the Atlantic, Pacific, and the Middle East. The commentary employs highly critical and derogatory language while outlining the alleged extensive wrongdoings attributed to the Secretary.

articles.title: Navy Researchers Scanned the Seafloor and Tracked a Ping. Then They Found a Staggering 500-Year-Old Shipwreck.
articles.summary: The French military made an accidental discovery, identifying what is now the deepest shipwreck ever found within French territorial waters. This significant find occurred during military operations, underscoring the unexpected contributions defence forces can make to maritime history and archaeology. The discovery potentially offers valuable insights into past naval activities or shipping within national maritime zones.
